VE01.footage: We will provide all the necessary footage, including interviews, crime scene photos, and any other relevant visual materials. We also have access to a library of stock footage for additional context.

VE01.purpose: The videos will be published on our YouTube channel, which is dedicated to long-form, single-case true crime documentaries. The goal is to build a loyal audience and increase views and engagement.
VE01.duration: Each video should be 40+ minutes in length. The aspect ratio should be 16:9, suitable for YouTube.
VE01.style: The style should be dark and dramatic, with a slow and suspenseful pace. The tone should be serious and respectful, avoiding sensationalism. The editing should be smooth and professional, with high production value.
VE01.music_text: Background music should be tense and atmospheric, fitting the true crime genre. Text and subtitles should be used to highlight key points and provide additional information. No specific script, but the editor should be able to write or adapt text as needed.
VE01.cover: The cover should be eye-catching and relevant to the case, with a title that clearly states the subject of the video. It should follow the branding and style of the channel.
VE01.reference: Take inspiration from channels such as Dr Insanity, Explore With Us, EWU Crime Storytime, Sinister Sins, Deadly Sins, and Red File. The videos should have a similar quality and style.
VE01.deadline: We aim to release one video per week, so the turnaround time for each video should be around 7 days.
VE01.ai_policy: AI can be used for minor tasks like color correction and audio enhancement, but the core editing and storytelling should be done by the editor.
